title: Recording the Insurer's Authorization and Planned Repair Days — Insurance Claim Repairs Desk Reference
content:
## What the record does

When the insurer's authorization of the original estimate is recorded on an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order, the repair order moves to authorized and its planned repair days are fixed. The planned repair days are entered with the authorization and are thereafter visible to the customer and the insurer.

**Timing of the planned repair days.** The planned repair days are fixed only after every customer-pay addition consent issued on the repair order stands signed or revoked.

Put the other way round: while any customer-pay addition consent issued on the repair order still stands awaiting the customer, its planned repair days are not fixed.

| Customer-pay addition consents issued on the repair order | Planned repair days may be fixed |
|---|---|
| none issued | yes |
| every one issued stands signed or revoked | yes |
| at least one still stands awaiting the customer | no |

## Capability

The tool records the insurer's authorization of the repair order's original estimate. The repair order moves from assigned to authorized, with today's authorization date and the planned repair days given, and the insurer's approval of the original estimate total is booked on the repair order's money history as an amount the insurer owes.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `record_insurer_authorization_cee3bb86`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_repair_id` | reference number of the Insurance Claim Repairs repair order being authorized, as the repair order lookup returns it | identifier, as returned |
| `estimated_repair_days` | the planned repair days fixed at authorization | a whole number of days, given as an integer with no fraction |

## Return

A receipt with:

- `claim_repair_id` — the repair order;
- `status` — "authorized";
- `authorized_date` — the authorization date, YYYY-MM-DD;
- `estimated_repair_days` — the planned repair days recorded;
- `approval_entry_id` — reference number of the booked insurer approval;
- `approved_amount_usd` — the original estimate total booked as approved, USD to 2 decimal places.

A receipt with `status` "authorized" confirms the authorization is recorded.

**Illustration (hypothetical values).** Repair order CR-2001 with 7 planned repair days returns status "authorized", today's date, 7 planned repair days, an approval reference and the original estimate total of that repair order as the approved amount.
